messages.subject: Hutchison Ports Thailand | Port growth, sustainability and stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Stephen Ashworth and Hutchison Ports Thailand Leadership Team,

Hutchison Ports Thailand sits at the center of trade, infrastructure and industrial supply chains in the Eastern Seaboard. That combination is highly relevant to my current operating experience.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My role spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate coordination, social performance and executive stakeholder strategy across a remote industrial operation where logistics continuity is business-critical.

I bring experience coordinating public agencies, contractors, communities and internal teams around operating approvals, infrastructure priorities and reputation-sensitive issues. My recent energy-transition and carbon-governance work adds a strong sustainability dimension.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand or regional roles across Corporate Affairs, Sustainability, Government Relations, Strategic Partnerships or country operations. I have attached a Hutchison Ports Thailand-focused executive CV for review.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
